label: Topic outside scope
definition: The work does not address the review topic.

label: No criminal actor or interest
definition: The evidence does not identify a criminal actor or interest.

label: No legal-economy link
definition: The evidence does not identify a target or relationship in the legal economy.

label: No infiltration relation
definition: The evidence does not support sustained access participation influence control or embeddedness.

label: Mention only
definition: The relationship is mentioned but is not substantively analysed.

label: Adjacent phenomenon only
definition: The work addresses a neighbouring phenomenon without the infiltration relation.

label: Crime-domain mismatch
definition: The criminal phenomenon is outside the review boundary.

label: Document type excluded
definition: The item does not meet the included scholarly document-type rule.

label: Language excluded
definition: The item falls outside the documented language rule.

label: Duplicate record
definition: Another canonical record represents the same scholarly work.

label: Not an academic source
definition: The item is outside the scholarly-source scope.

label: Full text unavailable
definition: The evidence required for a defensible decision could not be obtained.
